title: Day 20/28 - Deploy AKS Cluster In Azure With Terraform Custom Modules | Real time Project #1
description:
Welcome to 20/28 day of Terraform Full Course For Beginners

In this video, we will learn how to deploy an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster using Terraform custom modules. Perfect for DevOps engineers and cloud architects looking to master infrastructure as code with real-world scenarios.
Transform your Terraform skills as we break down complex deployments into reusable, maintainable custom modules. From creating service principals to setting up Azure Key Vault and deploying AKS clusters, this tutorial covers everything you need to automate your cloud infrastructure.

⚡️ What You'll Learn:
Master Terraform custom modules from scratch
Implement output variables effectively
Create a secure Service Principal using custom modules
Set up Azure Key Vault with Terraform
Deploy and configure AKS clusters programmatically
Best practices for production-grade deployments

Skip the trial and error—follow along as we build a production-ready AKS infrastructure using battle-tested Terraform practices. Whether you're preparing for your next DevOps role or upgrading your current infrastructure, this tutorial has you covered.
